citations.short: Establish reliability of supplier's C of A
citations.long: Establishment of the reliability of the closure supplier's report of analyses is deficient in that the test results are not appropriately validated at appropriate intervals.

citations.short: Validation lacking for sterile drug products
citations.long: Procedures designed to prevent microbiological contamination of drug products purporting to be sterile do not include validation of the sterilization process.
Written records are not made of investigations into unexplained discrepancies and the failure of a batch or any of its components to meet specifications.
Procedures designed to prevent microbiological contamination of drug products purporting to be sterile are not written.
Employees are not given training in the particular operations they perform as part of their function.

citations.short: Written calibration / inspection records not  kept
citations.long: Records of the calibration checks and inspections of automatic, mechanical or electronic equipment, including computers or related systems are not maintained.

citations.short: Results not used for expiration dates, storage cond.
citations.long: Results of stability testing are not used in determining expiration dates.
The written stability testing program is not followed.
